changelog: TUN: disabling TUN fully tears down the data plane (stack thread, socket threads and wintun session) instead of leaving the adapter connected forever
TUN: the virtual adapter is uninstalled when TUN is disabled, on a failed startup and when a duplicate start is rolled back
TUN: leftover adapters from older versions (SSLProxy, SSLProxy-1 ... -4) are removed on startup after residual routes are rolled back
